generatedCommentsNodes.comment: In the eager evaluation path of `Case`, the code uses `builder.copyFrom(lhs, p, p + 1)` and `builder.copyFrom(rhs, p, p + 1)`. Since these are single-position copies, calling the newly implemented type-specific single-position `copyFrom` methods (e.g., `LongBlockBuilder.copyFrom(LongBlock, int)`) would be more efficient than using the range-based copy, which involves additional overhead and internal loops for a range of size one.

The `perPosition` implementation for the lazy evaluators (e.g., `CoalesceBooleanLazyEvaluator`) creates a new `Page`, an `IntStream`, and several filtered blocks for every single position that requires evaluation. While the code comments acknowledge that this is not fast, the allocation pressure from creating these objects in a tight loop over thousands of positions is significant. If this path is frequently hit, it will likely become a bottleneck.
